cards.example: 西晋统一后，皇族争夺王位长期混战。
cards.exampleTranslation: After the Western Jin unified China, the imperial clan fought long wars for the throne.
cards.breakdown: 皇：白光闪耀的王（王），至高无上 · 族：旗帜（方）下聚集的一群人（矢）

cards.example: 宗室司马睿在长江以南建立东晋。
cards.exampleTranslation: Royal clan member Sima Rui established the Eastern Jin south of the Yangtze.
cards.breakdown: 宗：屋顶（宀）下供奉祖先的祭台（示） · 室：屋子（宀）里到达的地方

cards.example: 南方和北方政权更迭。
cards.exampleTranslation: Northern and southern regimes alternated in power.
cards.breakdown: 更：太阳升起又落下，交替更换 · 迭：走（辶）了一次又一次，反复交替

cards.example: 先后成立了16个政权。
cards.exampleTranslation: A total of 16 regimes were established one after another.

cards.example: 匈奴人攻入长安，西晋灭亡。
cards.exampleTranslation: The Xiongnu attacked Chang'an, and the Western Jin perished.
cards.breakdown: 灭：一横压在火上面，把火压灭了 · 亡：一个人躲进角落，不见了

cards.example: 杨坚夺取政权建立隋朝。
cards.exampleTranslation: Yang Jian seized power and established the Sui dynasty.
cards.breakdown: 夺：大力（大）抢走手中之物 · 取：用手（又）抓住耳朵（耳），古代战场割耳计功

cards.example: 公元581年，杨坚建立隋朝。
cards.exampleTranslation: In 581 CE, Yang Jian established the Sui dynasty.

cards.example: 北方少数民族向黄河流域迁移。
cards.exampleTranslation: Northern ethnic minorities migrated to the Yellow River basin.

cards.back: Xiongnu (nomadic people who attacked the Western Jin)
cards.example: 匈奴人攻入长安，西晋灭亡。
cards.exampleTranslation: The Xiongnu attacked Chang'an, and the Western Jin fell.

cards.example: 少数民族向黄河流域迁移。
cards.exampleTranslation: Ethnic minorities migrated toward the Yellow River basin.
cards.breakdown: 迁：走（辶）到新地方去 · 移：把禾苗（禾）从一处移到另一处

cards.back: to live mixed together (different ethnic groups)
cards.example: 他们同汉族长期杂居。
cards.exampleTranslation: They lived mixed together with the Han people for a long time.
cards.breakdown: 杂：衣服（衣）里混着不同的东西 · 居：屁股（尸）坐在一个地方住下来

cards.example: 民族界限日益缩小。
cards.exampleTranslation: Ethnic boundaries increasingly narrowed.
cards.breakdown: 界：田地（田）的分界线 · 限：山丘（阝）挡住去路的边界

cards.example: 民族界限日益缩小。
cards.exampleTranslation: Ethnic boundaries increasingly narrowed.
cards.breakdown: 日：太阳，一天天 · 益：水（水）满出皿中，越来越多

cards.example: 民族界限日益缩小。
cards.exampleTranslation: Ethnic boundaries increasingly narrowed.
cards.breakdown: 缩：丝线（纟）收紧变小 · 小：一点一点变得更小

cards.back: Xianbei people (nomadic group; founded Northern Wei)
cards.example: 北魏孝文帝使鲜卑族汉化。
cards.exampleTranslation: Emperor Xiaowen of Northern Wei sinicized the Xianbei people.

cards.back: sinicization / to adopt Han Chinese culture
cards.example: 北魏孝文帝进行改革，使鲜卑族汉化。
cards.exampleTranslation: Emperor Xiaowen reformed and sinicized the Xianbei people.

cards.example: 促进了北方民族的融合。
cards.exampleTranslation: This promoted the integration of northern ethnic groups.
cards.breakdown: 融：鬲（鬲）中加热使物质融化 · 合：上下两个口合在一起

cards.example: 两晋南北朝是中国历史上的动荡时期。
cards.exampleTranslation: The Two Jin and N-S Dynasties was a turbulent period in Chinese history.
cards.breakdown: 动：用力（力）让重物动起来 · 荡：水（氵）来回摇晃

cards.example: 由于连年战争，佛教盛行。
cards.exampleTranslation: Due to years of war, Buddhism became popular.
cards.breakdown: 佛：一个人（亻）领悟了最高的道理 · 教：用手（攵）传授知识

cards.example: 人民生活痛苦，因此佛教盛行。
cards.exampleTranslation: People's lives were full of suffering, so Buddhism became prevalent.

cards.example: 北魏孝文帝迁都洛阳，进行改革。
cards.exampleTranslation: Emperor Xiaowen moved the capital to Luoyang and carried out reforms.

cards.example: 绘画和书法水平很高。
cards.exampleTranslation: The level of painting and calligraphy was very high.
cards.breakdown: 绘：用丝线（纟）绣出美丽图案 · 画：用笔在框（凵）里描绘

cards.example: 书法家王羲之的《兰亭序》非常珍贵。
cards.exampleTranslation: Calligrapher Wang Xizhi's Preface to the Orchid Pavilion is extremely precious.

cards.example: 《女史箴图》和《兰亭序》都非常珍贵。
cards.exampleTranslation: The Admonitions Scroll and the Orchid Pavilion Preface are both extremely precious.
cards.breakdown: 珍：玉（王）一样珍稀 · 贵：贝壳（贝）价值很高

cards.back: pi (π) — the ratio of circumference to diameter
cards.example: 祖冲之把圆周率推算到小数点后7位数。
cards.exampleTranslation: Zu Chongzhi calculated pi to 7 decimal places.
cards.breakdown: 圆：圆圈（囗）里完整无缺 · 周：环绕一圈 · 率：比率

cards.example: 推算到小数点后7位数。
cards.exampleTranslation: Calculated to 7 digits after the decimal point.

cards.example: 祖冲之是最早把圆周率推算到小数点后7位数的人。
cards.exampleTranslation: Zu Chongzhi was the first to calculate pi to 7 decimal places.
cards.breakdown: 推：用手（扌）往前推进 · 算：竹（竹）做的算筹放在桌上计算

cards.example: 贾思勰写出了农书《齐民要术》。
cards.exampleTranslation: Jia Sixie wrote the agricultural treatise Essential Techniques for the People.

cards.back: Sima Rui — founded the Eastern Jin dynasty south of the Yangtze (317 CE)
cards.example: 宗室司马睿在长江以南建立东晋。
cards.exampleTranslation: Royal clan member Sima Rui established the Eastern Jin south of the Yangtze.

cards.back: Emperor Xiaowen of Northern Wei — reformed and sinicized the Xianbei people
cards.example: 北魏孝文帝迁都洛阳，进行改革。
cards.exampleTranslation: Emperor Xiaowen moved the capital to Luoyang and carried out reforms.

cards.back: Gu Kaizhi — famous painter; created the Admonitions Scroll (《女史箴图》)
cards.example: 画家顾恺之的《女史箴图》非常珍贵。
cards.exampleTranslation: Painter Gu Kaizhi's Admonitions Scroll is extremely precious.

cards.back: Wang Xizhi — the 'Sage of Calligraphy'; wrote the Orchid Pavilion Preface
cards.example: 书法家王羲之的《兰亭序》非常珍贵。
cards.exampleTranslation: Calligrapher Wang Xizhi's Orchid Pavilion Preface is extremely precious.

cards.back: Zu Chongzhi — mathematician; first to calculate pi to 7 decimal places
cards.example: 祖冲之是世界上最早把圆周率推算到小数点后7位数的人。
cards.exampleTranslation: Zu Chongzhi was the first person in the world to calculate pi to 7 decimal places.

cards.back: Jia Sixie — agronomist; wrote Essential Techniques for the People (《齐民要术》)
cards.example: 农学家贾思勰写出了农书《齐民要术》。
cards.exampleTranslation: Agronomist Jia Sixie wrote the agricultural treatise Essential Techniques for the People.
